load_rgb_image: load an RGB image from a file path with optional alpha compositing and resizing
load_depth_map: load a depth map image from a file path and resize to the target resolution
parse_view_args: parse a view arguments string with ranges and steps into a list of view IDs
load_camera_intrinsics: load camera intrinsic matrices from a file supporting multiple matrix formats
compute_psnr_ssim: compute PSNR and SSIM image quality metrics between prediction and ground truth arrays
